verdict.rationale: Alloy's docs index lists dedicated pages for assigning external entity IDs retroactively, supporting multiple external entity IDs, and merging entities. That is a first-party capability for reconciling customer records with external identifiers, but the evidence is only page titles and does not extend to case records. Missing for 10: any evidence of external identifiers on case or investigation records, documented detail on how external ID lookup, upsert and merge behave, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reconcile customer and case records with stable external identifiers

citations.quote: Retroactively Assigning an External Entity ID ... Multiple External Entity IDs ... Entity Merging
